name: price-action-backtest-plugin
description: Agent-native price action backtesting workflow for Webull market-data import, technical analysis, signal validation, and QuantSeras-style visualization reports.

interface.shortDescription: Backtest OHLCV or Webull historical bars with reports.
interface.longDescription: A Claude Code and Codex plugin for reproducible price-action and technical-analysis backtesting. The workflow can import read-only Webull historical bars to a local OHLCV CSV, compute common indicators, run deterministic long/cash signal backtests with costs and lookahead controls, export artifacts, audit outputs, and create QuantSeras-style dark HTML reports.
defaultPrompt: Fetch Webull historical bars and backtest them.
